verdict.rationale: Docs strongly support fast provisioning via console/API/CLI with quickstart guides, search-offer commands, SSH/Jupyter connect, and templates (vast-ai-docs-1,2,3,34,41,43,48). However, independent hands-on reports describe inconsistent reliability, bandwidth, and setup friction compared to major clouds, suggesting the 'minutes to running code' experience isn't always smooth. missing for 10: independent benchmark of actual boot-to-code time, and resolution of reported reliability/bandwidth variability.
